record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: Let D1 and D2 be admissible subcategories of Db(X1) and Db(X2), respectively, where X1 and X2 are smooth projective varieties over a field K. Is every exact fully faithful functor F: D1 -> D2 of Fourier-Mukai type?

evidence.quote: Is any exact fully faithful functor

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field and let $X_1, X_2$ be smooth projective varieties over $K$. Denote by $D^b(X_i) = D^b(\operatorname{Coh}(X_i))$ the bounded derived category of coherent sheaves on $X_i$. Recall that a full triangulated subcategory $\mathcal{D} \subset D^b(X)$ is called admissible if its inclusion functor admits both a left and a right adjoint. An exact functor $F: \mathcal{D}_1 \to \mathcal{D}_2$ between admissible subcategories $\mathcal{D}_i \subset D^b(X_i)$ is said to be of Fourier–Mukai type if there exists an object $E \in D^b(X_1 \times_K X_2)$ such that $F$ is isomorphic to the restriction to $\mathcal{D}_1$ of the functor $\Phi_E: D^b(X_1) \to D^b(X_2)$, $\Phi_E(-) = R(p_2)_*\bigl(E \otimes^{\mathbb{L}} L p_1^*(-)\bigr)$, composed with the projection onto $\mathcal{D}_2$.

Question: Is every exact, fully faithful $K$-linear functor $F: \mathcal{D}_1 \to \mathcal{D}_2$ between admissible subcategories of $D^b(X_1)$ and $D^b(X_2)$ of Fourier–Mukai type?
artifact.status_search_result: Orlov's theorem establishes Fourier–Mukai representability for fully faithful exact functors between the full bounded derived categories $D^b(X_1) \to D^b(X_2)$ of smooth projective varieties. The extension to fully faithful functors between admissible subcategories is not known in general and is highlighted as an open question in surveys on Fourier–Mukai functors (Canonaco–Stellari). Counterexamples of Rizzardo–Van den Bergh show that the fully faithful hypothesis cannot be dropped, but they do not address the admissible-subcategory case.

status_evidence.title: Fourier–Mukai Functors: a Survey (Canonaco–Stellari)
status_evidence.snippet: Orlov's representability theorem for fully faithful exact functors between bounded derived categories of smooth projective varieties; extensions and open problems related to admissibility and projectivity hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: The Fourier–Mukai representability question for fully faithful functors between admissible subcategories is discussed as an open direction.

status_evidence.title: An example of a non-Fourier-Mukai functor between derived categories of coherent sheaves
status_evidence.snippet: Rizzardo–Van den Bergh construct an exact functor between derived categories of smooth projective varieties which is not of Fourier–Mukai type.
status_evidence.claim: Without the fully faithful hypothesis, exact functors between derived categories need not be Fourier–Mukai.
